subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep the work as narrower memory-plugin and channel-plugin improvements?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses memory authority, persisted storage shape, workspace-file precedence, conflict resolution, and channel delivery semantics; current main has useful pieces but no settled product contract for the proposed layer.

options.title: Keep as design tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split narrower work
options.body: Track Feishu self-mention loss and bot-to-bot delivery in focused channel issues or PRs, and open separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want that direction.

options.title: Route through plugin APIs
options.body: Require durable rule learning to prove it cannot be built through memory/plugin APIs before adding core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep as design tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest sampled cross-surface history across memory docs, prompt/context, and Feishu runtime boundaries.
